build_cgf1_evaluator: build a CGF1Evaluator instance to evaluate segmentation predictions against COCO ground truth files
run_cgf1_evaluation: run cgF1 evaluation on a predictions JSON file using the CGF1Evaluator.evaluate method
create_cococustom: create a COCOCustom instance for fast loading and indexing of COCO dataset annotations
compute_iou_matching: compute IoU between predictions and ground truth using Hungarian algorithm matching in CGF1Eval
summarize_cgf1_metrics: summarize cgF1 evaluation results including precision, recall, F1, IL_FPR, and IL_MCC metrics
